title: coefficient fields
semantics: Edges point to prerequisites; dependencies are conjunctive; one alternative route suffices. Reviewed source topology, not a kernel proof trace.
conventions: Carriers, hypotheses, quantifiers and constant scope are recorded per node and in the corresponding Lean declarations.

nodes.title: Slice class IsSlice: h in C¹[0,∞) with h = O(r⁻³) as r → ∞ (sealed )
nodes.source_hypotheses: h is one fixed-u radial slice, a continuous real function of r on [0,∞) ( /; the source writes the u = 0 slice h(0,r))
nodes.source_conclusion: IsSlice h holds iff (i) h ∈ C¹[0,∞[ (derivative at r = 0 one-sided within [0,∞), ) and (ii) h(r) = O(r⁻³) as r → ∞; the first two conditions of the Theorem 1 data class ; the condition on ∂h/∂r is not included
nodes.constant_scope: none (the O-constant and threshold in (ii) are existential and depend only on h)

nodes.title: Closed ball of radius x in the space X of (7.1) on the strip [0,u₀]×[0,∞) (MemXBall)
nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H is a continuous real function of (u,r) on the quadrant [0,∞) × [0,∞) (field carrier , reused), with slices H(u,·); values of H for u > u₀ are unconstrained
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞)
nodes.source_conclusion: MemXBall u₀ x H holds iff (1) for every u in [0,∞) with u ≤ u₀ the slice lift s ↦ H(u, s⁺) is C¹ (ContDiffOn of order 1) on [0,∞), with the derivative at s = 0 one-sided within [0,∞) ; (2) the map (u,r) ↦ ∂_r H(u,r), the derivative within [0,∞) at r of the lift s ↦ H(u⁺, s⁺), is continuous on the closed strip [0,u₀] × [0,∞); (3) for every u ≤ u₀ and every r ≥ 0, (1+r)³ abs(H(u,r)) + (1+r)⁴ abs(∂_r H(u,r)) ≤ x. Fields (1)-(2) are "continuous and posess a continuous partial derivative with respect to r" of (7.1) (continuity of H itself is the carrier's); field (3) is ‖H‖_X ≤ x for the printed sum norm (7.1) (U-NORMS), i.e. membership in "the closed ball of radius x₁ in the space X" of Lemma 1 with x₁ = x . No evolution equation and no ∂_u H are assumed
nodes.constant_scope: the radius x is an explicit parameter of the predicate, not existential ; the double sup over u then r of (7.1) is replaced by the equivalent pointwise bound for all u ≤ u₀ and all r ≥ 0

nodes.title: Each slice H(u,·), u ≤ u₀, of a field in the X-ball of radius x is in IsSlice (MemXBall.isSlice)

edges.rationale: the premise hH; its field (1) at u ≤ u₀ is verbatim the C¹[0,∞[ conjunct of IsSlice, since the slice lift s ↦ (H.curry u)(s⁺) is definitionally s ↦ H(u, s⁺)
the conclusion is IsSlice of the slice, i.e. its C¹ and O(r⁻³) conjuncts (class printed at https://doi.org/10.1007/BF01205930 (p. 348))

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number; H is a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with MemXBall u₀ x H ; u ≤ u₀
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with MemXBall u₀ x H, for each u in [0,∞) with u ≤ u₀
nodes.source_conclusion: IsSlice(H(u,·)): the slice h = H(u,·) (H.curry u) is C¹[0,∞[ (one-sided derivative at r = 0, ) and h = O(r⁻³) as r → ∞. Reconstructed: [P] never states that the elements of X have slices in a slice class
nodes.constant_scope: none in the statement (the O-constant and threshold of IsSlice are existential per slice and may a priori depend on u); the proof's witness is the radius x, which does not depend on u (see #slice-decay)

nodes.title: The slice lift s ↦ H(u, s⁺) is O(s⁻³) as s → ∞, with constant x

edges.rationale: field (3) at u ≤ u₀ and r = s⁺, dropping the nonnegative derivative term, gives (1+s)³ abs(H(u, s⁺)) ≤ x for s ≥ 0; for s > 0, abs(H(u, s⁺)) = (1+s)⁻³ (1+s)³ abs(H(u, s⁺)) ≤ s⁻³ (1+s)³ abs(H(u, s⁺)) ≤ x s⁻³, using only (1+s)⁻³ ≤ s⁻³ and (1+s)³ abs(H) ≥ 0, so x ≥ 0 is not needed
the bound abs(H(u, s⁺)) ≤ x·abs(s⁻³) for all s > 0, in particular for all large s, gives O(s⁻³) at ∞

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x real; H continuous on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with MemXBall u₀ x H ; u ≤ u₀
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each H with MemXBall u₀ x H, for each u in [0,∞) with u ≤ u₀
nodes.source_conclusion: abs(H(u, s⁺)) ≤ x s⁻³ for every s > 0, hence (s ↦ H(u, s⁺)) = O(s⁻³) as s → ∞
nodes.constant_scope: the bound constant is the radius x of the hypothesis, the same for every u ≤ u₀

nodes.title: An eventual bound gives a big-O estimate
nodes.source_hypotheses: f, φ real functions on ℝ; C real; abs(f(s)) ≤ C·abs(φ(s)) for all sufficiently large s
